inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed 2.9.0-dev1 integrated glTF/GMX/TEX/BBX mod staging, dev28 TXIF graph, dev27 scene graph, dev26 mesh graph, dev25 retail GMX evidence, native builders, extraction/research and source-only gates are inherited. dev2 removes vertex/material schema donor requirements in an explicit synthesis mode.

gmx_native_schema_synthesis.inherited_external_retail_gate: dev25 306/306 mesh-bearing retail GMX no-op byte-identical plus plr_001 topology smoke

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 76/76 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Native TEX payloads still require a compatible donor layout/header; arbitrary Xenos/RSX texture layout synthesis is not implemented.
Unknown/custom GMX vertex semantics are not synthesized; dev2 covers the decoded standard POSITION/NORMAL/TEXCOORD_0/COLOR_0 mapping.
Novel MTRL parameter names are structurally encodable but only have runtime meaning if the selected native shader recognizes them.
MOTN/ANIM graph synthesis/import, platform shader compilation, and fully template-free GMX creation remain unresolved.
Retail runtime acceptance of arbitrary donor-free synthesized models remains a separate hardware/emulator gate.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX evidence is inherited rather than re-run from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
